title: The Rank of the Imperial Envoy
next_chapter_hook: The Imperial Envoy revealed: 'Chen Tianming's final task left behind was related to the Imperial Court.' What does this mean? Did the missing father already set up a game even Chen Ji didn't know about?

text.content:
The crescent moon hung like a hook on the jagged mountain ridge.

Chen Ji sat cross-legged at the edge of an abandoned well, the Demonic Path Commander's words 'rewrite the ancient chess game' still echoing in his Mental Sea. He slowly opened his eyes, a faint golden pattern glinting in the depths of his pupils—the sign of the Tianji Record Fragment reawakening.

'Three days...' he murmured to himself, fingertips caressing the yellowed ancient page in his sleeve. Three consecutive visions of the future had consumed fifteen points of Heavenly Fate, leaving his luck as thin as a cicada's wing.

The night wind carried a scent of blood from the east, where the three major sects were locked in fierce battle against the Demonic Path.

Yet at this moment, footsteps unrelated to the battlefield were drawing near.

"Chen Gongzi has refined taste, able to sit peacefully when war approaches."

The voice was cold as icy spring water, coming from behind a blue stone three zhang away. Chen Ji's brow center twitched—he had not sensed this person approaching with his spiritual awareness.

The newcomer wore a pure white official robe, embroidered with a nine-clawed golden toad on the chest. That was... the Imperial Court's emblem.

"Might I ask who..." Chen Ji rose slowly, his expression perfectly displaying three parts wariness and three parts confusion. Twelve years of playing the cowardly废物disciple had carved the act into his bones.

The white-robed figure stepped from the shadows, moonlight illuminating a young yet somber face. He slightly cupped his hands in greeting—courteous but laced with condescending arrogance.

"This one is Zhao Xuanming, an official of the Imperial Court's Bureau of Astronomy. By order of my superior, I specially came to pay respects to Chen Gongzi."

dialogue.content:
"Imperial Court?"

Chen Ji's brow slightly lifted, his fingers secretly touching the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve. This fragment had a hidden characteristic—when foresight involved 'higher beings,' the text would become blurred. Zhao Xuanming dared to come alone; he must be relying on something.

"Zhao大人's intelligence network is indeed efficient. I am merely a servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect. What merit qualifies me to alarm the Imperial City?"

Zhao Xuanming gave a light laugh, but the smile didn't reach his eyes. "Why does Chen Gongzi undervalue yourself? A Tianqing Sect servant who survived the Demonic Path Saintess, who laid plans under the very eyes of three sects for seven years, and who also obtained—"

He paused, gaze burning.

"—the Tianji Record."

text.content:
The air suddenly froze.

Chen Ji's smile stiffened on his face, pupils slightly contracting. This momentary loss of composure was quickly concealed, but Zhao Xuanming had clearly seen it.

"Chen Gongzi need not be tense." Zhao Xuanming stood with hands clasped behind his back, tone flat as discussing the weather. "If I wanted to expose you, I would have informed the three sects three days ago. Why travel thousands of miles, coming alone?"

He stepped forward.

"I come with sincerity. The Imperial Court wishes to make a transaction with Chen Gongzi."

In the distance, Ye Qing's demonic energy quietly approached, only to be blocked by an invisible barrier. Chen Ji's heart stirred—she was being kept out; the visitor's cultivation was unfathomable.

dialogue.content:
"Transaction?"

Chen Ji slowly lowered his gaze, concealing all alarm and vigilance deep within. When he raised his head again, the servile smile of a废物disciple had returned to his face.

"Zhao大人 jests. What could a废物 like me possibly offer the Imperial Court?"

Zhao Xuanming gave him a knowing look, one that reminded Chen Ji of a rabbit being watched by a hunter—though he knew, ultimately, he was the true hunter.

"The Tianji Record." Zhao Xuanming spat out three words. "Or rather, the 'Mr. Mo' behind the Tianji Record."

Chen Ji's heart jolted violently, yet his expression remained utterly unmoved.

The existence of Mr. Mo was his deepest secret. What kind of entity had come that could investigate to this extent?

text.content:
Zhao Xuanming seemed very satisfied with his reaction.

"Chen Gongzi need not play dumb. You and I both know the Tianji Record is a supreme treasure of ancient prophecy, capable of glimpsing Heavenly Secrets and foresight." His voice dropped lower. "And the Demonic Path's large-scale invasion this time is far from coincidental."

He waved his hand, and a profound light unfolded between the two.

It was a map, marking the three major sects, the Demonic Path Holy Sect, and... a vast sphere of influence that had never appeared in any classic.

"The Imperial Capital." Zhao Xuanming pointed to the northernmost part of the map. "And above the Imperial Capital, a place even cultivators cannot peer into—the Heavenly Court Ruins."

Chen Ji's breath slightly hitched.

dialogue.content:
"What are you trying to say?"

Chen Ji's tone cooled. The mask of a废物remained, but his words carried much more seriousness.

Zhao Xuanming stared directly into his eyes: "The true force behind the Demonic Path's invasion is not the Demonic Path Commander, but the entity within the Heavenly Court Ruins. That entity—"

He took a deep breath.

"—is the same as the 'Heavenly Path Will' worshipped by the Imperial Court's ancestors for generations."

The night wind turned bitterly cold.

Chen Ji recalled what Mr. Mo had said: 'The Tianji Record is merely one of the pieces the Heavenly Path has placed in this world.' At the time, he hadn't understood; now... he seemed to be beginning to comprehend.

"So what does the Imperial Court need me to do?" he asked.

text.content:
Zhao Xuanming put away the map, his expression growing solemn.

"The Imperial Court needs Chen Gongzi's Tianji Record to find something in the Ancient Forbidden Land about to open—the Mirror of Heavenly Fate."

"Mirror of Heavenly Fate?"

"A divine artifact the Heavenly Path Will used to monitor all beings in ancient times." Zhao Xuanming explained. "The Demonic Path is also searching for it. If we get it first, we can completely seal the Heavenly Court Ruins and sever the Heavenly Path Will's interference in the mortal world."

He looked at Chen Ji, his gaze carrying a hint of seduction.

"In exchange, the Imperial Court is willing to tell Chen Gongzi a piece of news—regarding your father Chen Tianming's final task left behind that year."

Chen Ji's pupils violently contracted.

Father's task? Related to the Imperial Court?

"Why should I trust you?"

Chen Ji's voice cooled, the cowardice of a废物fading considerably at this moment. He stared directly at Zhao Xuanming, his gaze like the cold depths of a pool.

"The Imperial Court stands high above, all-seeing. Why bother collaborating with a废物disciple? This transaction... is too suspicious."

Zhao Xuanming sighed lightly.

"Because the Tianji Record is the only supreme treasure capable of remaining conscious before the Mirror of Heavenly Fate." He said candidly. "The scouts the Imperial Court sent all lost contact after entering the Forbidden Grounds—their spiritual awareness was devoured by the Mirror of Heavenly Fate. But the Tianji Record... was亲手crafted by the Heavenly Path, and in theory can resist this erosion."

He paused, then added: "As for the trap Chen Gongzi worries about—I can first tell Chen Gongzi the content of your father's task that year. True or false, Chen Gongzi can judge for yourself."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a moment.

Zhao Xuanming's proposal was too tempting. What had his father been planning before his disappearance? Tianji Record, Imperial Court, Heavenly Path Will... these clues intertwined rapidly in his mind.

He thought of Ye Qing.

That woman controlled by the Demonic Path Holy Sect for many years was still blocked outside by the barrier. The Demonic Path also coveted the Forbidden Grounds and the Mirror of Heavenly Fate—if he rashly cooperated with the Imperial Court, what would Ye Qing think?

But if he didn't cooperate...

"Zhao大人." Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his tone meaningful. "You say the Imperial Court wants to seal the Heavenly Path Will. But as I understand it, successive Imperial Court emperors all claimed to be mandated by heaven. Is this... betraying your own ancestors?"

Zhao Xuanming's expression slightly darkened.

"Chen Gongzi is indeed clever." He coldly smiled. "Indeed, there are factional struggles within the Imperial Court. Our faction advocates severing the Heavenly Path's control over the mortal world. As for the conservative faction..."

He didn't finish, but the meaning was already clear.

"So this isn't just a war between the Imperial Court and the Demonic Path." Chen Ji slowly said. "It's also the Internal strife between the Imperial Court's reformist and conservative factions."

text.content:
Zhao Xuanming nodded.

"Chen Gongzi is indeed perceptive." His tone carried more appreciation. "The conservative faction has been entangled with the Heavenly Path Will for years, with deeply rooted influence. We need to enlist every force possible."

He looked at Chen Ji, gaze burning.

"And Chen Gongzi... you share the same lineage as your honored father and hold the Tianji Record. You are the most suitable candidate."

Chen Ji didn't immediately answer. He turned to look toward where Ye Qing was isolated by the barrier.

After a moment, he turned back, his harmless smile back on his face.

"Zhao大人 has traveled far; Chen Mou should provide proper hospitality." He cupped his hands. "Only this matter carries great weight; please allow me some time to consider."

Zhao Xuanming's eyes slightly narrowed.

"How long does Chen Gongzi need?"

choice.prompt: The Imperial Court envoy awaits your reply. What is hidden behind Zhao Xuanming's proposal? Is he testing you, or does he genuinely come with sincerity?

choices.text: Make superficial perfunctory remarks while secretly using the Imperial Court
choices.description: First extract more intelligence before deciding whether to cooperate. The Imperial Court can provide clues about your father—this favor cannot be wasted.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the golden opportunity for cooperation
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, will completely offend the Imperial Court

text.content: Chen Ji showed an agonized smile. "Three days. After three days, Chen Mou will give Zhao大人 an answer." He paused, probing: "Only I wonder... can Zhao大人 first reveal a bit about my father's task that year?" Zhao Xuanming narrowed his eyes, studying him for a moment. "Chen Gongzi is indeed cautious." He took out a jade slip from his sleeve. "This contains the record of your honored father's contact with the Imperial Court that year. Consider it... a deposit."

choices.text: Firmly refuse and draw clear boundaries
choices.description: Imperial Court involvement will only complicate the situation. Rather than being manipulated by higher-level chess players, better to maintain the status quo.

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, his smile turning cold. 'Lord Zhao's kindness, Chen Mou accepts with gratitude. But I'm merely a废物杂役, and have no desire to meddle in these great affairs.' Zhao Xuanming's expression slightly darkened. 'Young Master Chen truly wishes to refuse?' His tone carried hints of threat. Chen Ji sneered in his heart—here it comes, is this the true face of the imperial court?

choices.text: Wait for the right price, strive for initiative
choices.description: Make no decision, but also do not refuse. Use Father's clues as leverage to demand more from the imperial court.
choices.visible_cost: May be used by both sides

text.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, then suddenly asked: 'Lord Zhao mentioned the imperial court needs the Tianji Record. But if I help the imperial court obtain the Heavenly Mirror, what can they give me?' A flash of surprise appeared in Zhao Xuanming's eyes, quickly replaced by admiration. 'Young Master Chen truly is a man who accomplishes great things.' He mused, 'Beyond clues about your father, the imperial court can also offer one opportunity for 'Heavenly Secrets Divination'—conducted personally by our imperial Grandmaster, divining fortune and misfortune for Young Master Chen.'

Zhao Xuanming's words stirred Chen Ji's heart. Heavenly Secrets Divination—this was an imperial court secret technique, said to glimpse futures even further than the three-hour window, though the cost was immense. If he could obtain this divination opportunity... he might see clues about his sister Chen Nian, and the true face of the Heavenly Will. But his expression remained unchanged, merely furrowing his brows slightly. 'Sounds tempting.' he said unhurriedly, 'But Lord Zhao, don't forget—I hold the Tianji Record, and that itself is the greatest bargaining chip. When the Forbidden Grounds open, it's you seeking me, not the other way around.' Zhao Xuanming's smile faded somewhat. 'What Young Master Chen means is...'

'What I mean is—' Chen Ji stepped forward, the first time he had actively approached this imperial envoy. 'If the imperial court truly has sincerity, then show it first.' His voice was not loud, yet each word was clear, 'Regarding my father's mission, regarding the Heavenly Will, regarding the layout of the Forbidden Grounds—Lord Zhao surely knows more than just this?' Zhao Xuanming's gaze changed. This废物杂役... was far more difficult to deal with than imagined. 'What does Young Master Chen want?' 'I want to meet the Grandmaster.' Chen Ji said each word deliberately, 'Not through your retelling—I want to ask in person.' A smile curved his lips, carrying锋芒 that no废物弟子 should possess. 'Can Lord Zhao make this decision?'

dialogue.content: Zhao Xuanming fell silent. His gaze studying Chen Ji grew increasingly grave. This was not the bearing a废物 should have, nor the见识 a杂役弟子 should possess. Tianqing Sect's废物 Chen Ji... was indeed, as rumored, an act. 'Very well.' After a moment, Zhao Xuanming nodded, 'At the Forbidden Grounds entrance three days from now, I will arrange for Young Master Chen to meet the Grandmaster.' He drew a token from his sleeve and tossed it to Chen Ji. 'This is an imperial passage token. If Young Master Chen wishes to enter the city early, this token grants direct audience with the Grandmaster.' Chen Ji caught the token—it was warm to the touch, with dragon qi faintly flowing within. He was secretly astonished—the weight of this token probably exceeded even Zhao Xuanming's official rank. The imperial court this time... truly bled for this.

text.content: 'Lord Zhao is indeed straightforward.' Chen Ji tucked the token into his sleeve, his smile growing more sincere, 'Then Chen Mou shall not be polite.' He paused, then shifted topics. 'By the way, before Lord Zhao leaves, I have one small question.' Zhao Xuanming's brow furrowed slightly. 'Please ask, Young Master Chen.' Chen Ji pointed to the barrier outside that separated Ye Qing. 'Lord Zhao's handiwork—isn't this the imperial court secret technique '困龙锁'?' His tone was casual, 'My friend has an impatient disposition, and is probably growing anxious. Why doesn't Lord Zhao release his divine art first, and we can continue our discussion next time?' Zhao Xuanming's expression stiffened slightly. He actually saw through my technique? This废物... '...Young Master Chen has sharp eyes.' He took a deep breath and raised his hand to dissolve the barrier. Almost simultaneously, a surge of demonic energy burst forth, and Ye Qing's figure appeared in view. She coldly swept a glance at Zhao Xuanming, then turned her gaze to Chen Ji, eyes filled with questioning. —Is this person friend or foe?

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slightly shook his head, signaling her to remain calm. 'Lord Zhao, regarding cooperation, I will give an answer in three days.' He cupped his hands, his smile returning to the humble demeanor befitting a废物弟子, 'It's late, Lord Zhao must be weary from the journey. Why not rest in town for the night?' Zhao Xuanming gazed at him deeply. 'No need.' He turned away, his white robes fluttering in the night wind, 'See you at the Forbidden Grounds entrance in three days.' His figure vanished like flowing light into the northern night sky. Chen Ji watched him depart, his smile gradually fading. 'Ye Qing.' he called softly. The demonic path saintess floated to his side, her voice cold: 'Imperial court person? What does he want?' Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then briefly recounted the previous conversation. Ye Qing's brow furrowed tighter and tighter. 'Heavenly Mirror... Heavenly Will...' she murmured, 'Chen Ji, do you know what this means?'

text.content: 'It means this demonic path invasion might only be part of a larger chess game.' Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried an icy chill. 'The demonic path commander spoke of 'rewriting the eternal chess game,' the imperial court mentions Heavenly Will... connecting these clues, there is only one possibility.' He raised his head, gazing at the war-torn night sky. 'Someone wants to restart the Heavenly control over the mortal world. And we—' He looked at Ye Qing, his gaze profound. '—might all be on that board.' Ye Qing was silent for a long while. 'So what do you plan to do? Meet the imperial court Grandmaster?' Chen Ji did not answer immediately. He drew the imperial token from his sleeve, staring at the flowing dragon qi upon it. After a moment, he spoke softly: 'My father had contact with the imperial court twenty years ago, leaving behind a 'final mission.'' His voice was soft, yet carried a certain resolve. 'What this mission is... I must find out.'

Ye Qing gazed at his profile, then suddenly asked: 'Do you suspect... that your father already knew something back then?' Chen Ji nodded. 'My father disappeared when I was five. He left nothing—except that incomplete Tianji Record.' His fingers gently rubbed the token, 'I always thought he simply died in an accident. But now it seems...' He took a deep breath. 'He knew too much. So much that... he had to disappear.' Ye Qing reached out, gently pressing his shoulder. 'I'll go with you.' Her voice was soft, yet carried unwavering resolve, 'Whatever schemes the imperial court harbors, we face them together.' Chen Ji turned to look at her, a flicker of warmth in his gaze. '...Alright.'

The night wind gradually subsided, a streak of dawn appearing in the eastern sky. Chen Ji tucked the token into his sleeve and turned to gaze toward Tianqing Sect. There awaited Su Qingyao, who was still waiting for his news. 'Let's go back first.' he said, 'Some things... still need to be arranged.' Ye Qing nodded. The two figures vanished into the morning light. Yet in the imperial capital a thousand li away, within a tower shrouded in clouds and mist, an elderly man in dark robes slowly opened his eyes. 'He accepted the token?' the old man asked. Zhao Xuanming respectfully lowered his head: 'Yes, Grandmaster. However... this person is far more troublesome than the intelligence suggested. He saw through the困龙锁 I arranged.' The old man was silent for a moment, then suddenly smiled. 'Interesting.' His voice was aged yet full of vigor, 'No wonder he's the son of Chen Tianming. If he were truly a废物, the old one would be disappointed.' 'What does the Grandmaster mean...?' 'Tell him about his father.' The old man waved his hand, 'But only half. The other half... wait until he enters the Forbidden Grounds.'

Zhao Xuanming received his orders and withdrew. The old man stood alone atop the tower, overlooking the imperial capital at his feet. 'Chen Tianming...' he murmured, 'What was the final mission you left behind all those years ago?' He closed his eyes, and memories surged like tides. Twenty-three years ago, a young man named Chen Tianming came to the imperial capital, bringing an earth-shattering secret—the Heavenly Will was not invincible. He stayed in the capital for three months, conversing three times with the emperor of that era, then... vanished. No one knew where he went. But he left behind words: 'If a descendant comes bearing the Tianji Record, tell them—the mission is half complete. The rest lies within the Forbidden Grounds.' The old man opened his eyes, his gaze profound. 'Chen Ji... will you be the one to end your father's chess game?'
